tool.name: eScriptorium
tool.description: segment, transcribe and train models on images and PDFs

param.name: title
param.label: Document name
param.help: Defaults to Document 1, Document 2, and so on.

param.name: pages
param.label: Pages
param.help: Images and PDFs are added in the selected or collection order; each PDF adds all its pages at its position.

param.name: input_models
param.label: Models
param.help: Segmentation and recognition models. The model type is detected automatically.

tool.help: Opens eScriptorium with a project named Galaxy that holds one document per **Document** input. Supported inputs are: - **Pages**: images and PDFs in the order selected or in collection order - **Models**: segmentation and recognition models, uploaded automatically Exports created in eScriptorium and all new models of the session are added to the history as separate datasets when the tool is stopped, so wait for an export to finish before stopping the tool.
